name: unofficial-coss-origin-mcp
description: Unofficial Model Context Protocol server for the COSS Origin component library — recipe lookup, variant search, easing reference, doc search, and JSX lint as a frontend designer's second brain.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/server.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun ./scripts/prepend-shebang.ts && chmod +x dist/server.js
scripts.snapshot: bun scripts/crawl.ts && bun scripts/normalize.ts && bun scripts/index.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
